'''''Themor''''' was the name given to two [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport]]s that were used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].

==History==
''Tremor'' were part of a group of ships that were sent to [[Capture of ZA-13|retake]] [[ZA-13]], a [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] originally used to manufacture [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperdrive]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]] for [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Advanced]] fighters, that could also be mounted onto [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]]. After [[Attack on ZA-13|driving]] of [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin's]] [[Zaarin's fleet|forces]], ''Themor'', which both carried troops, were to dock with the facility and deploy the troops into the factory then jump into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] after ''[[Java]]'' captured it.
